run_grpc_interop_test_client: run the gRPC interoperability test client against a server with a specified test case and port
create_secure_channel_with_credentials: create a secure gRPC channel with SSL credentials and optional OAuth or JWT call credentials
create_stub_for_test_service: create a TestServiceStub or UnimplementedServiceStub from a gRPC channel based on the test case
parse_interop_client_args: parse command line arguments for server host, port, test case, TLS, and OAuth scope settings
test_grpc_interoperability: test gRPC interoperability by parsing args, creating a channel and stub, then running the selected test case
